_comment: PPC strategy configuration. Campaign roles are matched by regex against the campaign name, first match wins, evaluated in the order listed. Thresholds drive the scale/cut rules in src/amazon_ads/search_terms.py. Edit here rather than in code.

descriptions.discovery: Finds new converting terms — auto, broad, loose match. Judged on terms harvested, not ACOS.
descriptions.profit: Harvested exact/phrase keywords run at or under break-even ACOS. The margin engine.
descriptions.ranking: Time-boxed pushes on hero ASINs to win rank. Tolerates ACOS above break-even on purpose.
descriptions.defense: Protects own listings and brand terms from competitor conquesting.

targets._comment: Optional target bands for each role's share of ad spend in the selected window, as percentages. Used for a visual hint only — nothing enforces or auto-adjusts budgets. Set a role to null to opt it out of the hint.

thresholds._comment: Scale/cut rules. acos values are percentages. Windows end at the LA closed-day as-of.

placement._comment: Top of Search modifier recommendations. Compares TOS against the other on-Amazon placements for the SAME campaign over a closed-day window. Recommendation only — nothing is ever written to Amazon.

windows._comment: Search-term loop windows, in days, inclusive and ending on the LA as-of date.

learning._comment: Action decision log and outcome snapshots. Observation only — no model is trained and no bid is ever written from this data.

organic_rank_gating._comment: Do not bid aggressively on queries we already own organically. Amazon's Ads API does NOT expose organic SERP rank — rank here comes from Brand Analytics Search Query Performance, a manual override, or an external tracker. This is a cannibalization GUARD, not an incrementality measurement: it says 'we may already get this click for free', not 'this ad click was wasted'.
organic_rank_gating._default_asin_comment: Search-term rows carry no ASIN, so rank is joined on this ASIN unless the action names one. Set to the primary ASIN; add per-campaign mapping later if campaigns diverge by product.
